title: Chapter 60 Ayub Joins
content:
Chapter 60 Ayub Joins

Wang Shuo's heart trembled slightly when he heard the news.

It's only been two days since we had a good time. Is a new struggle about to start?

After returning to the territory, he found that there was nothing unusual. Wang Shuo summoned Duan Wenxi, Suo Yong and others to the meeting hall for a meeting.

Now Wang Shuo has his own team, and he can't help but feel a little proud.

In the hall, in addition to the cavalry team, there are three managers and the blacksmith Matar.

The atmosphere suddenly became a little depressing. Everyone had known each other for a short time and was not familiar with each other. Wang Shuo didn't speak, and no one said anything casually.

Wang Shuo looked around and felt that everyone who could help him make decisions was here, so he cleared his throat and said: "Everyone heard the system announcement just now!"

"I heard it."

"Do you have any suggestions for this?"

Everyone was silent, and they didn't know how to answer. Tools basically don't have the ability to make suggestions!

But Wang Shuo did not exclude them. After all, they were his confidants, and other refugees might not know that they were tools, which was beneficial for him to manage the village.

"Just say it!" Wang Shuo added awkwardly, and then glanced at Duan Wenxi.

The latter immediately understood and said, "Boss, I think we should quickly reinforce our walls. If wild beasts attack, if a beast tide forms, our current walls may not be able to withstand it!"

"I think we should take the initiative and organize everyone to upgrade their levels!" Hua Tianxiong also said actively.

"The current equipment situation in the territory is still relatively backward, and we should vigorously build equipment." Matar also suggested.

As long as someone takes the lead, everyone begins to actively offer suggestions.

After seeing this, Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction, and everyone got to the point.

"You are right. I decided to set up a militia reserve team first, with Hua Tianxiong as the captain."

"Establish a civilian management center to manage those who do not want to become militias separately, and Duan Wenxi will manage them."

"Suo Yong should speed up the construction of the blacksmith shop and complete it today."

"In addition, Hua Tianxiong, how many blacksmiths do we have?"

"Only 4."

"Okay, these 4 blacksmiths will be assigned to Matar to make armor and weapons with all their strength, so as to arm our militia as soon as possible."

"We have set up a cavalry squad, and I am currently in charge of the command. Excellent militiamen can join the cavalry team after being assessed."

"Yes, Lord." Everyone said in unison.

"Dismiss."

After everyone left, Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to hurry up and earn enough military merit points to recruit Ayub.

At first, he planned to recruit a few more ordinary soldiers to increase the number of his cavalry team. At present, it seems that high-end combat power is more important than the number of people. If he encounters a powerful enemy, he will be in trouble.

After lunch, Wang Shuo looked around the wall.

He found that some beasts of level 1 to 3 had appeared in the distance, such as hunting dogs, antelopes, etc. These were mobile experience packs and food!

His cavalry squad was not used to fight such non-threatening monsters.

Entering the ancient battlefield, Wang Shuo did not waste a moment and continued to clear out the skeleton soldiers in the Gobi Desert.

He quickly earned 13,000 military merit points.

Wang Shuo immediately found Zhao Bangde and recruited Ayub.

[ID: SAC56787852 Ayub]

[Level: Level 20]

[Belonging to: Wana Village (Wang Shuo)]

[Loyalty: 100/100]

[Strength: 37]

[Constitution: 35]

[Agility: 21]

[Energy: 16]

[Evaluation: He was once a king, but later fell. 】

(Qualification: A-level, each level up provides 5 free attribute points.)

[Combat attribute panel]

[Attack power: 37]

[Defense power: 30]

[Skills: Thunder Spear Technique]

[Health value: 2350]

[Skills: Sweeping the Thousands of Troops, Iron Cavalry Charge, Purple Thunder Breaking the Sky]

[Equipment: None]

Seeing the A-level qualification, Wang Shuo was shocked. This is the best person Wang Shuo has seen so far, and he also has three skills.

In one word, strong.

The cloth-clothed strong man in front of him is nearly 2 meters tall. His strong muscles are looming, and his invisible aura gives people a strong sense of oppression.

Wang Shuo felt uncomfortable just standing in front of him.

If he hadn't seen that the loyalty was 100/100, Wang Shuo would have wanted to be on guard.

"Ayub, meet the Lord."

"Okay, okay." Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction.

He quickly added him to the cavalry squad, and then exchanged for a warhorse and a cavalry job transfer certificate.

After collecting a set of excellent equipment, his combat effectiveness was improved to a higher level.

With Ayub joining, Wang Shuo wanted to challenge the Skeleton Knight.

He spurred his horse and rushed directly into the orange area.

There is not much difference between the orange area and the yellow area, mainly because the types and levels of the undead creatures inside are different.

Not far away, he saw a level 18 Skeleton King.

"Ayub, go!" Wang Shuo wanted to see his strength, after all, his level was 20.

It shouldn't be a problem to single out a level 18 wild monster.

Ayub solved the battle neatly, in less than 30 seconds.

This battle gave Wang Shuo great confidence.

And he felt that he was about to upgrade again.

The Gobi here was flatter, especially suitable for cavalry charge.

It seemed that this was an excellent place to train cavalry. Wang Shuo began to imagine the scene of his cavalry fighting wantonly in this Gobi.

Soon they encountered a skeleton knight, this time a single knight, and Wang Shuo checked his attributes.

[Skeleton Knight]

[Level: Level 12]

[Attack Power: 200]

[Defense Power: 20]

[Health: 2000]

[Skill: Raid. ]

[Evaluation: A second-level undead soldier in the ancient battlefield, good at raiding, and extremely fast moving speed. ]

Seeing that his attack power was actually 200, Wang Shuo looked solemn.

The Skeleton Knight moves very fast and has high attack power. Gong Zheng's shield seems to have no effect. He must rely on superb combat skills to avoid the opponent's attack.

The fighting style of exchanging injuries for injuries is no longer advisable.

It seems that the later battles require higher and higher combat skills.

The Skeleton Knight in the distance saw Wang Shuo and others, and rushed over directly regardless of whether they were outnumbered.

Wang Shuo could feel that it was like a very fast truck, rushing towards him at full speed.

There was no other way except to dodge.

Just when Wang Shuo was afraid, Ayub did not hesitate to meet the opponent and speeded up his horse.

I saw Ayub, holding a bronze halberd, riding away.

The setting sun was setting, and the setting sun was like blood.

The afterglow of the setting sun shone on him, scattering bursts of light.

At this moment, he was like a god of war, full of an unmatched momentum.
